products.name: Jamf AI Governance
products.note: Native AI control plane for macOS fleets, GA July 1, 2026; discovery and policy enforcement for on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints

profile_text.body:
Jamf, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, describes itself as a provider of device management and security software exclusively focused on Apple hardware. The company's site states it helps organizations manage Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV devices at any scale, connecting users to resources and protecting against cyber threats. Jamf describes itself as the only company offering a complete management and security solution for Apple-first environments, and notes it has over 20 years of experience along with same-day Apple OS support. IDC MarketScape positioned Jamf in the Leaders Category for Worldwide Unified Endpoint Management Software for Apple Devices in its 2025–2026 Vendor Assessment.

On the AI side, Jamf tracks one product in this space: Jamf AI Governance, categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. It is described as a native AI control plane for macOS fleets, covering discovery and policy enforcement for both on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints, with general availability set for July 1, 2026.

The site's held facts show Jamf has a notable legal footprint, with 93 cases recorded in Minnesota, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data.
